verdict: ESCALATE - the benches are discordant on the core case and the surviving posture is a price-gated entry rather than a kill. Red 7/10 REJECT with a FATAL; blue 7/10 PARTIALLY OVERTURNED, demoting that FATAL to SIZING and leaving PGY explicitly 'starter eligible' on a named price band. Two documents, same conviction, materially different dispositions of the decisive fact - that is the escalation trigger, and the fact itself is worth escalating because it is a mechanism the desk will meet again on every originate-to-securitize name. Start with what both benches agree the screen got wrong. The dd52 of -0.527 is measured off a roughly $44.99 high set in September 2025, before the 2026-02-09 guide-down crash to a $10.40 low. The name has since doubled, up 103.8% off that low, and re-rated 37% in three sessions on a 7/30 beat-and-raise, so at roughly $21.20-21.46 it sits about 4.7% BELOW its 26-week high, not in a live drawdown. The blob sweep fired on 2026-08-07, after the gap had already closed. The triage said this itself and classified DAMAGE-ABSENT on the earnings-quality axis with a genuinely good argument: the classic bear case on Pagaya is that GAAP profit is fair-value-mark alchemy, and the Q2 composition refutes it directly - investment income net was MINUS $0.8M, contributing nothing, and the $45.3M of net income was earned THROUGH a $42.3M retained-asset loss, with 94.5% of revenue ($365.6M of $387.0M) being cash fees. Volume grew 33% to $3.5B and the FY26 GAAP net income guide was RAISED to $155-180M. Red's FATAL attacked the one leg that made this capital-light: the claim that H1 operating cash flow of $117.9M against net income of $70.0M represents 1.68x cash conversion. Red pulled the H1-26 investing section - purchases of investments in loans and securities of $496.0M against proceeds and sales of $365.1M, a net retained-book build of $130.9M exceeding the $117.9M of operating cash flow, and net investing of -$134.8M - and concluded that company-level free cash flow is negative, that every dollar of operating cash plus $13M more goes into buying retained interests in its own securitizations, and that this is a levered consumer lender's funding treadmill wearing a fee network's income statement. Blue verified red's numbers as exact and then found that red had stopped at the investing subtotal. H1 financing was secured borrowing of +$185.2M against -$127.5M, net +$57.7M, total net financing +$31.0M, and CASH ROSE $16.1M to $249.3M ($304.4M including restricted). The 'treadmill consuming every operating dollar plus $13M' does not survive the full statement. Blue's ruling - FATAL demoted to SIZING - is correct and precisely drawn: what genuinely REMAINS refuted is 'capital-light', because retention purchases run about 7% of H1 volume, the book is partly debt-funded with secured borrowing now at $253.0M, and GAAP net income does not reach shareholders as free cash flow while volume grows 33%. What DIES is 'negative company-level FCF' and the treadmill framing. A roughly 5-7% mandatory-retention build scaling with volume is the cost of growth in this model, not hidden burn. This is the third instance in this batch of a prosecution manufacturing a FATAL from a truncated instrument read (see also CSHR red's wrong-venue absence claim and UAMY red's transcript-over-8-K inversion), and blue named it as such: 'red attacked the strongest leg - right target - but proved it with a truncated statement, exactly the artifact this bench exists to catch.' Blue reduced two more red findings on solid grounds. Retained losses of $80.3M YTD against $43.3M, up 85% against volume up 33%, are a LAGGING flow off the accumulated book rather than off current volume - the retained book itself grew far faster than 33%, so '2.6x volume' overstates deterioration, and 'annualized $160M approximately equals the NI guide' is rhetoric since the $155-180M guide is struck AFTER those losses. Direction remains a real watch item; the framing does not survive. And the FRLPC compression from 4.8% to 4.2% with fee-per-volume from 12.0% to 10.3% is confirmed as data but only PLAUSIBLE as an adverse-selection mechanism - mix shift into POS and auto is an undischarged alternative, management bounded the metric at 4-5%, and absolute FRLPC dollars still grew about 16%. Blue also disconfirmed red's ABS-window scenario with live evidence: an $800M ABS in January 2026 and $3.7B raised in Q2 across six securitizations. Funding access is demonstrably open. What survives on both benches is timing and dilution. Diluted shares went from 64.5M to 79.7M and, implied from Q2's $45.3M over $0.49, to roughly 92M - about 16% year over year - though blue's caveat matters: part of the jump is anti-dilutive instruments entering the count on the swing to profitability, a methodology effect rather than issuance, and H1-26 financing shows NO equity raise. President Sanjiv Das sold 21,289 shares at $22.00 on 8/03, the pop's peak session, with two Form 144s the same day - roughly $470k, a tell rather than a kill, and the 10b5-1 status is unverified. And the entry is the problem: buying a doubled stock 4.7% off its 26-week high with no confirmed catalyst for roughly 62 trading days is momentum, not dislocation rescue. Under the response taxonomy blue applied the doctrine exactly right - the surviving objection is about PRICE, and a valuation objection gates PRICE only. Hence a named band rather than a kill, and hence the escalation. || SESSION RULING: ESCALATION RULED: price gate STANDS at $17.00-18.50 (blue's band) but entry is BLOCKED until the cap-structure + concentration note is read from primary — the 403 wall that blocked it is now passable (sec_fetch for the session, proxy for benches). Red's FATAL correctly demoted (stopped at the investing subtotal; financing +$31.0M, cash ROSE $16.1M). No order rests until the read clears.
reopen_gates: PROVISIONAL - the escalation sets the disposition. Blue's surviving position is 'starter eligible' on either (i) a pullback toward the pre-print gap of roughly $17.00-18.50, or (ii) a Q3 print showing retained-loss growth at or below retained-book growth with FRLPC at or above 4.0%. Against the current $21.46 the price gate is roughly 14-21% below spot, so nothing is actionable today - but it is a live standing gate, not a kill, and it needs an owner.

ESCALATION MUST RESOLVE: whether a mandatory risk-retention build of roughly 5-7% of volume, debt-funded, is correctly classed as the cost of growth (blue) or as a structural claim on every future dollar of operating cash (red). The two readings differ on whether PGY is a fee network at ~10.6x or a levered lender-hybrid at ~12x dilution-adjusted, and that is the entire sizing question.

HARD PRECONDITION on any entry, from blue: read the cap structure and the 10-Q concentration note FIRST. Warrant and convert overhang is UNREAD on both benches behind an SEC 403, and the TENX lesson applies - no per-share or EV claim before the contingent claims are pulled.

Verify the $155-180M guide is ATTRIBUTABLE-TO-PAGAYA rather than consolidated: blue found $18.2M of distributions to noncontrolling interests in H1 and flagged the guide basis as UNVERIFIED. If the guide is consolidated, the ~10.6x headline multiple is wrong on the numerator.

10-Q concentration and fair-value notes showing retention purchases FALLING as a percentage of volume - i.e. pass-through deals replacing retained risk. This is red's own change-my-mind condition and it is the cleanest single test of which reading is right.

Two consecutive quarters of retained-loss growth at or below retained-BOOK growth (not volume growth - blue's correction). The retained-book denominator was never pulled on either bench; it is a coverage gap that must close before this metric can be graded.
Dilution decelerating below about 5% per year, with the anti-dilutive-instrument methodology effect stripped out.

fdic_call_reports on the partner banks - UNCHECKABLE on both benches and the one genuinely relevant matched connector. Partner-bank consumer charge-offs are the independent read on Pagaya paper quality and nothing else in the atlas touches the verdict axis.
